analysis.rationale: Consolidated PAT grew 30.7% YoY to ₹915.99 crore, driven by strong revenue growth and stable margins. Appointment of seasoned banker Prashant Kumar signals governance strengthening.
analysis.summary: Board approved Q1 FY27 results with consolidated PAT up 30.7% YoY to ₹915.99 crore, appointed Prashant Kumar as Additional Independent Director, and approved reclassification of Nabha Power from promoter to public.
